support_definitions.source:
pop_typically_counts_as_middle_strata = { # Pop scope
    OR = {
        is_pop_type = shopkeepers
        is_pop_type = engineers
        is_pop_type = bureaucrats
        is_pop_type = officers
        is_pop_type = academics
        is_pop_type = clergymen
        is_pop_type = farmers
    }
}

law_is_governance_principles_law = { # law scope
    OR = {
        type ?= law_type:law_monarchy
        type ?= law_type:law_theocracy
        type ?= law_type:law_social_monarchy
        type ?= law_type:law_corporate_state
        type ?= law_type:law_chiefdom
        type ?= law_type:law_presidential_republic
        type ?= law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
        type ?= law_type:law_council_republic
    }
}

law_intermediate_edo_system = {
	group = lawgroup_edo_social_system

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/social_hierarchy_codified.dds"

	progressiveness = -50

	on_enact = {
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
	}

	modifier = {
		country_strata_samurai_high_qualification_growth_same_class_mult = -0.1
		country_strata_samurai_low_qualification_growth_same_class_mult = -0.3
		country_strata_commoners_townspeople_qualification_growth_same_class_mult = -0.4
		country_strata_commoners_peasants_qualification_growth_same_class_mult = -0.4
		country_strata_outcastes_qualification_growth_same_class_mult = -0.5

		country_strata_religious_qualification_growth_other_class_mult = -0.4
		country_strata_commoners_townspeople_qualification_growth_other_class_mult = -0.4
		country_strata_commoners_peasants_qualification_growth_other_class_mult = -0.4
		country_strata_outcastes_qualification_growth_other_class_mult = -0.5

		country_strata_samurai_high_acceptance_min_add = 80
		country_strata_samurai_low_acceptance_min_add = 60
		country_strata_religious_acceptance_min_add = 60
		country_strata_commoners_townspeople_acceptance_min_add = 40
		country_strata_commoners_townspeople_acceptance_max_add = 79
		country_strata_commoners_peasants_acceptance_min_add = 40
		country_strata_commoners_peasants_acceptance_max_add = 79
		country_strata_outcastes_acceptance_max_add = 19
	}

	ai_enact_weight_modifier = { #Petitions
		value = 0

		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
}

law_subjecthood = {
	group = lawgroup_citizenship

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/imperial_subjecthood.dds"

	progressiveness = -25

	on_enact = {
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
			}
			custom_tooltip = subjecthood_fervor_no_effects_ld_tt
		}
	}

	can_impose = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_citizenship_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}

	unlocking_laws = {
		law_monarchy
		law_theocracy
		law_chiefdom
		law_colonial_administration
	}

	modifier = {
		country_authority_add = 100
		state_assimilation_mult = -0.25
		country_support_separatism_resistance_mult = -0.5
		country_support_separatism_strength_mult = -0.5

		#If primary culture, only apply this value
		country_acceptance_primary_culture_add = 100
		country_acceptance_homeland_add = 30
		country_acceptance_not_homeland_add = 0

		#Heritage
		#From this block, we only apply the highest value a Pop qualifies for
		country_acceptance_shared_heritage_trait_add = 20
		country_acceptance_shared_heritage_trait_group_add = 15
		country_acceptance_no_shared_heritage_trait_add = 0

		#Language
		#From this block, we only apply the highest value a Pop qualifies for
		country_acceptance_shared_language_trait_add = 20
		country_acceptance_shared_language_trait_group_add = 15
		country_acceptance_no_shared_language_trait_add = 0

		#Tradition
		#From this block, we only apply the highest value a Pop qualifies for
		country_acceptance_shared_tradition_trait_add = 25
		country_acceptance_no_shared_tradition_trait_add = 0
	}

	acceptance_modifier = {
		country_radicalism_increases_violent_hostility_mult = 0.2
		country_radicalism_increases_cultural_erasure_mult = 0.1
		country_loyalism_increases_second_rate_citizen_mult = 0.05
		country_loyalism_increases_full_acceptance_mult = 0.1

		country_allow_voting_violent_hostility_bool = no
		country_allow_voting_cultural_erasure_bool = no
		country_allow_voting_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_voting_power_open_prejudice_mult = -0.25
		country_allow_voting_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_voting_full_acceptance_bool = yes

		country_allow_assimilation_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_full_acceptance_bool = yes

		country_political_strength_violent_hostility_mult = -0.4
		country_political_strength_cultural_erasure_mult = -0.3
		country_political_strength_open_prejudice_mult = -0.2
		country_political_strength_second_rate_citizen_mult = -0.1
